name: Cynthia Lane
notable_stories: C-002: John Lane confirmed as Cynthia Lane's father. Missouri as key geographic node. High confidence lineage anchor. Documents from Bill Allen confirm linkage.
milestones: Married George Francis Adams (#1) (m. 14 Jan 1841, Chariton County, MO)
Daughter of John Lane; her 1841 marriage to George Francis Adams facilitated his settlement in Missouri on land grants originally set aside for War of 1812 veterans
sources: Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen (2 April 2011 edition)
Further Research on the Family and Descendants of Joseph P. and Elizabeth (Hamilton) Adams, William W. Allen (February 2012)
Family letters in Bill Allen’s family document
Family research emails, 2011–2013 (John and Barbara Adams with Irma Kulp Zacher, George F. Adams, Bill Allen and others)
notes: John Lane = Cynthia Lane's father confirmed. Already in canonical as 'Daughter of John S. Lane' — consistent.
Per the 1898 biography, mother of four sons and four daughters, all living in 1898 [Bill Allen, Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, 2011, line 4343]
DPBR: mother of four sons and four daughters, all living in 1898. [Bill Allen, Further Research, 2012, line 6958]
Sources disagree: A biographical record says she died in Missouri in 1861; her husband’s obituary implies 1863. [Bill Allen, line 6956]

Open question: The marriage record of George Francis Adams #1 and Cynthia Lane indexes the groom as 'George T.' and misspells Cynthia; the date and place of the marriage are not given in the email text [Family research emails, email 18]

Open question: no marriage record has been found for George F. Adams (#1) and Cynthia Lane. Their Missouri home is only thought to be Marion, MO, and it is unknown whether Jos. moved to Missouri with them. [Family research emails, email 20]
